textos.texto: Ana has many plans for the future. First she is going to finish her degree in computer science: she has two semesters and then she is going to graduate. Her goal is a good job in a company, but her dream is another one: she is going to emigrate and move abroad. Her sister is a permanent resident in Canada and she is going to apply for the citizenship next year. Ana hopes for the same opportunity. She is going to plan all: first the English, then the money for the flight, and finally the visa. She practises English every day, because it is very important for her project. Maybe in two years she is going to leave Peru. It is not sure: she does not have all the money and the visa is difficult. But Ana is not going to change her plan: she is going to get a better job abroad. Her family and her friends are going to visit her, and together they are going to be well.

First they are going to plan all the project, then they are going to learn a new language of computer science, and finally they are going to open the website for all the campus. It is a big project, but it is also an opportunity: with it Paul is going to get a better job. He hopes for a scholarship too. Maybe in one year the university is going to pay for the project. textos.texto: The dream of Laura is not a job: it is music. Next year she is going to travel to England for six months. First she is going to work in a café to get the money, then she is going to book the flight, and finally she is going to apply for the visa. It is not sure, because the visa is very difficult and it is also expensive. Her parents are not happy with this plan: they hope for a good job for her, in a school of the city. But Laura is not going to change her goal. In England she is going to play the guitar and she is going to sing in small parties. Maybe she is going to stay there one year. Her friend Ana is going to travel with her for two weeks in the summer, and together they are going to visit London. It is a big project for a student, but Laura is sure: her future is the music. She is going to decide in March.

textos.texto: Lee must decide: two subjects or a job. His university is going to open a new semester in August and he has an opportunity: a company wants him for four hours every day. The money is very good and it is also his subject, computer science. But then he is not going to have time for all his classes and maybe he is going to fail one exam. First he is going to speak with his teacher, then with his parents, and finally he is going to decide in July. His goal is to graduate in two years, so a small grade is a problem. His dream is a big company in the United States, so this job is important for his future. Lee hopes for the two things: the job and the degree. Maybe he is going to study at night and work in the morning. It is not going to be easy, but he is sure: he is not going to change his plan. In August he is going to start.

textos.texto: Marie has a plan for the next year and she is sure. First she is going to finish her degree in science in June, then she is going to work six months in a hospital, and finally she is going to apply for a scholarship abroad. Her goal is a big project with her classmates: a website of science for the students of her city. It is an opportunity, because with it maybe she is going to get a better job. Her dream is another one: she hopes to travel to England and to sing in small parties, because music is very important for her. Her parents are not happy with this plan, but Marie is not going to change it. She is also going to move to another city with her sister and together they are going to book a small apartment. It is not going to be easy, but she is going to decide in March.
